column1: # Prose that restates a pin from scripts/lib/pins.tsv, so a person following
# the doc installs the version CI runs. scripts/update-pins.sh rewrites these
# together with the workflow pin, so its monthly PR needs no hand edits;
# scripts/check_versions_test.go fails when a listed copy disagrees with the
# pin, or when a tracked file states the version without being listed here.
#   marker  only lines containing this text are rewritten
#   prefix  what precedes the version in the prose ("v" for v2.14.0, "-" none)
#   file    the file, relative to the repo root
